top_signals.title: Drone Companies Will Eventually Consolidate: Kahyaoglu
top_signals.summary: Ward McNally, founder, co-CEO and managing partner of McNally Capital, Sheila Kahyaoglu, senior equity research analyst at Jefferies, and Anita Antenucci, founder & managing partner of 3Wire Partners, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss the wave of new investing in defense companies comes amid global tensions and conflict. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Novogratz Joins Crowd Warning of AI Bubble, Says Pile In Anyway
top_signals.summary: The chorus of billionaire investors opining about an artificial-intelligence bubble is expanding, and Michael Novogratz, for one, says the speculative frenzy in technology stocks will keep growing.

top_signals.title: Trump doesn't think Russia plague incident is bioweapon, plans Putin call Wednesday
top_signals.summary: Nearly 200 people were placed under medical observation earlier this week in Russia's Irkutsk region in eastern Siberia over suspected exposure to plague.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hertz Lenders Team Up With Advisers as Possible Debt Fight Looms
top_signals.summary: Creditors to Hertz Global Holdings Inc. are organizing across at least two groups, bracing for potential negotiations with the car rental company over its billions of dollars of debt that comes due over the next few years, according to people familiar with the matter.
